description: eiapy is a Python wrapper for querying the United States Energy Information Administration API. Its README shows a request for hourly electricity flow between California and Mexico and returns timestamped values with series metadata. Users specify a series identifier and API configuration; outputs are energy time series for subsequent processing. Geographic coverage follows the EIA series selected. GitHub metadata states MIT licensing for the client, with EIA data rights and API limits controlled by the provider. A limitation is that the illustrated request uses an older series-command format; compatibility with the current EIA API should be checked before relying on it. The tool can prepare interconnector flow or fuel-demand observations for energy-network simulations. The related OSeMOSYS catalogue model is a scenario optimiser, not an EIA client. No EIA data or package was downloaded.
name: eiapy EIA energy-series client
